title: ECL Conformance Bundle-Stage Input v1
description: The artifact of a vector at the conformance runner's bundle stage (conformance/README.md): EBMP-2 records offered together as one complete causal bundle. The stage reads only the records member; any other member is ignored. It analyses the records as one causal graph and does not validate each record against the EBMP-2 schema.

records.description: The records of the bundle, in any order. An entry that is not a JSON object is reported as ecl.error.schema-invalid.v1 at the bundle stage, and the other entries are still analysed.
